description: ValidationPolicy::new(now_unix) was added in PKIX-aoe. Before adding #[non_exhaustive] (deferred from PKIX-s54.1), update all external struct literals to use the constructor. Files: pkix-chain/tests/e2e.rs (4x), pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs (1x), pkix-path/tests/anchor_nc.rs (1x), pkix-path/tests/pkits_smoke.rs (1x), pkix-path/tests/pkits_helper.rs (1x), pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs (1x). Pattern: ValidationPolicy { current_time_unix: t, ..Default::default() } → ValidationPolicy::new(t). Then add #[non_exhaustive] to the struct. This is a pre-requisite for the v0.2 policy-field roadmap.
title: ValidationPolicy: update struct literals to use new(), then add #[non_exhaustive]
